selection.summary: Issue #1241 fix: ZSTD_window_init in lib/compress/zstd_compress_internal.h (ZSTD_window_t functions, lines ~600-694) should initialize window.base/index to start-1 (reference starting at 1) instead of start, so the first input position is a valid match offset even on first use of a context. Relevant delivered evidence covers ZSTD_window_init/ZSTD_window_clear and ZSTD_window_update definitions in that header region.

sidecar.claim_ceiling: Confirmed delivery and declared final selection only; neither proves semantic use.

source_projection.claim_ceiling: Only exact unchanged source lines map to base coordinates. Changed/inserted lines receive no base-context credit.
